name: codex-last-mile-verifier
description: Guided live discovery, installation, and invocation verification for Codex plugins and skills with reusable evidence and pass/fail reporting.

interface.shortDescription: Standardize real Codex discovery, install, and smoke-test verification for plugins and skills.
interface.longDescription: Codex Last-Mile Verifier packages a guided live verification workflow for Codex plugins and skills. It creates reusable run artifacts, drives a consistent discovery and install checklist, records evidence, and produces a final pass or fail summary without pretending local validation can replace the real Codex runtime.
defaultPrompt: Use Codex Last-Mile Verifier to create a live verification run for this local plugin and guide the real Codex discovery, install, and smoke-test flow.
Run a last-mile verification for this Codex skill and produce a standard pass/fail report with evidence and recommended fixes.
Verify whether this locally prepared Codex extension is discoverable, installable, and invokable in the actual Codex runtime.
